en: A pleasant series of musical notes that form a tune; or the main tune in a piece of music.
ex: She hummed a sweet melody while she was cooking.
她煮飯時哼著甜美的旋律。

en: The state of being a member of a club or organization; or the people who belong to a group; or the number of members.
ex: She paid a yearly fee for her gym membership.
她付了年費辦健身房會員。

en: The ability to remember things; or something that you remember from the past; or the part of a computer that stores data.
ex: She has a good memory for faces and names.
她對臉孔和名字記得很清楚。

en: To say or write something about someone or something briefly; or a short reference to someone or something.
ex: She never mentioned her plans to leave the company.
她從未提過要離開公司的計畫。

en: A unit of length equal to 100 centimeters; or a device that measures the amount of something, such as electricity or taxi fares.
ex: The swimming pool is fifty meters long.
這座游泳池長五十公尺。

en: Twelve o'clock at night; or the middle of the night.
ex: The party ended at midnight.
派對在午夜結束。

en: A unit for measuring distance, equal to about 1.6 kilometers.
ex: The school is about two miles from my house.
學校離我家大約兩英里。

en: Relating to the army, navy or air force; or the armed forces of a country.
ex: He did his military service after graduating from university.
他大學畢業後服了兵役。

en: Small and not very important; or a person who is not yet legally an adult; or a secondary subject of study.
ex: It was only a minor problem, and we fixed it quickly.
那只是個小問題，我們很快就解決了。

en: To put different things together so they become one; or to combine; or to be socially friendly with others.
ex: Mix the flour, eggs and sugar in a large bowl.
把麵粉、雞蛋和糖在大碗裡混合。

en: A small copy of something; or a person who shows clothes in fashion shows; or a perfect example for others to copy.
ex: She works as a fashion model in Paris.
她在巴黎擔任時裝模特兒。

en: The way you feel at a particular time; or the atmosphere in a place or group.
ex: He was in a good mood after winning the game.
他贏了比賽後心情很好。

en: The act or process of moving; or a movement of the hand or head to show something; or a formal suggestion in a meeting.
ex: The train slowly started to move, and the scenery was in motion.
火車慢慢開動，風景也隨之移動。

en: A two-wheeled vehicle with an engine that you ride like a bicycle.
ex: He rides a motorcycle to work every day.
他每天騎機車上班。

en: A large cup with a handle that you drink hot drinks from; or to attack someone to steal their money.
ex: She drank hot chocolate from a big mug.
她用一個大馬克杯喝熱巧克力。

en: Relating to music; or good at or fond of music; or a play or film with songs and dancing.
ex: They went to see a famous musical in London.
他們去倫敦看了一部著名的音樂劇。

en: Small in width; or not wide; or limited in size or range; or to become less wide.
ex: The road is too narrow for two cars to pass.
這條路太窄，兩輛車無法通過。

en: A country with its own government and territory; or all the people who live in a country.
ex: The whole nation celebrated the victory.
全國都在慶祝這場勝利。

en: Existing in nature and not made by people; or normal and what you would expect; or in a person from birth.
ex: She has a natural talent for music.
她對音樂有天賦。

en: Behaving badly, especially children; or slightly rude or improper.
ex: The naughty boy hid his sister's toys.
那個頑皮的男孩把他姊姊的玩具藏起來。

en: Not far away; or in a place close to where you are.
ex: We had lunch at a nearby restaurant.
我們在附近的一家餐廳吃了午餐。

en: Almost but not completely; or very close to something.
ex: It's nearly midnight, and we should go to bed.
快午夜了，我們該去睡覺了。

en: Needed in order to achieve something; or that you must have or do.
ex: It is necessary to wear a helmet when riding a bicycle.
騎腳踏車時有必要戴安全帽。

en: A piece of jewelry that you wear around your neck, such as a chain with beads.
ex: She wore a beautiful gold necklace to the wedding.
她戴著一條漂亮的金項鍊去參加婚禮。

en: A thin, pointed piece of metal with a hole at one end for sewing; or a thin pointed object like a pine needle or a medical injection tool.
ex: She threaded a needle and sewed the button back on.
她穿好針把釦子縫回去。

en: Not hopeful, or expressing disagreement; or harmful or bad; or a photographic film image; or less than zero.
ex: Try not to be so negative about everything.
試著別對每件事都那麼負面。

en: A person who lives near you or next to you; or to be next to something.
ex: Our neighbor often brings us fruit from her garden.
我們的鄰居常把她花園裡的水果送給我們。

en: Not one and not the other of two things or people; or also not.
ex: Neither of my parents can speak French.
我父母兩人都不會說法語。

en: The son of your brother or sister, or the son of your husband's or wife's brother or sister.
ex: My nephew is five years old and loves cars.
我的姪子五歲，很愛車子。

en: A system of lines or connections; or a group of computers connected together; or a group of people who help each other; or to meet people for work.
ex: The company has a network of offices around the world.
這家公司在世界各地設有辦事處網絡。

en: The daughter of your brother or sister, or the daughter of your husband's or wife's brother or sister.
ex: My niece is learning to play the piano.
我的姪女正在學彈鋼琴。

en: Not any; or no one; or not at all.
ex: None of the students knew the answer to the question.
沒有一個學生知道這個問題的答案。

en: Used after 'neither' or after a negative to add another negative.
ex: He did not call, nor did he send a message.
他沒有打電話，也沒有傳訊息。

en: A long written story about imaginary people and events; or new and unusual.
ex: She is reading a long novel about a young girl.
她正在讀一部關於年輕女孩的長篇小說。

en: To do what someone or a rule or law tells you to do.
ex: Children must learn to obey their parents and teachers.
孩子們必須學會聽從父母和老師。

en: Easy to see or understand; or clear to everyone.
ex: It is obvious that she has been crying.
很明顯她一直在哭。

en: To happen; or to exist or be found somewhere; or to come into your mind.
ex: An idea suddenly occurred to me while I was walking.
我走路時突然想到一個點子。

en: To give someone something that they can accept or refuse; or to say that you will do something; or something offered.
ex: He offered me a cup of tea when I arrived.
我到的時候，他請我喝了杯茶。

en: Relating to a government or an organization in authority; or a person who has a position of authority in an organization.
ex: English is the official language of many countries.
英語是許多國家的官方語言。

en: To use or control a machine; or to work in a particular way; or to cut open the body to treat an illness.
ex: The surgeon will operate on the patient tomorrow morning.
外科醫生明天早上要幫病人動手術。
